2. Amendment of section 3 of
Ordinance II of 1980.‑‑In the Balochistan Local Government
Ordinance, 1980, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, after clause
(b) of subsection (72) of section 3, the following proviso shall be added:
"Provided
that worker should be employed or should be self‑employed Craftsman or
worker earning wages within the limits of the Local Council to which seat he
has to contest election.".

Amendment of section 17 of Ordinance II of 1980

BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE I OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th January, 1999]
No. LEGIS.2-30/LAW/75-IX, dated
14-1-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 12th
January, 1999, is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 17 of
Ordinance II of 1980.‑‑In the said Ordinance, after subsection
(2) of section 17, the following new subsection shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(3) Every nomination shall
be made by a separate nomination paper in the prescribed form on solemn
affirmation made and signed by the candidate, accompany‑‑
(i) a declaration that he has
consented to the nomination and that he fulfils the qualification and is not
subject to any of the disqualification being elected as a member;
(ii) a declaration that no loan, obtained from Government any
bank, financial institution, cooperative society or corporate body in his own
name or in the name of his spouse or dependent children or dependent parents or
any business concern mainly owned by the aforesaid, remains unpaid on due date
and he has not defaulted the payment of loan;
(iii) a declaration that he, his
spouse or dependent children or dependent parents or a business concern mainly
owned by the aforesaid have not made any default in payment of taxes or
Government dues and utility expenses including telephone, electricity, gas and
water charges etc;
(iv) a statement specifying his
educational qualifications, occupation, National Identity Card Number and date
of birth/age;
(v) a statement of assets and
liabilities of his own, spouse and dependents on the prescribed form as on the
preceding thirtieth day of June;
(vi) an assurance that he shall
abide by the Code of Conduct issued by the Election Authority;
Explanation.‑‑For the
purpose of this section the expression‑‑
(a) "loan" shall mean
the loan, advance credit or finance obtained;
(b) "mainly owned"
shall mean holding of controlling or majority interest in a business concern;
(c) "taxes" includes
all taxes levied by Federal, Provincial or Local authorities;
(d) "Government dues"
includes rent charges of rest houses or lodges owned by the Federal Government,
Provincial Government, Local Authorities or Corporations established or
controlled by such Governments."

Insertion of section 18-A in Ordinance II of 1980

BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE I OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th January, 1999]
No. LEGIS.2-30/LAW/75-IX, dated
14-1-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 12th
January, 1999, is hereby published for general information:--
4. Insertion of section 18‑A
in Ordinance II of 1980.‑‑In the said Ordinance after section
18, the following new sections shall be added, namely:‑‑
"18‑A.‑‑Assistance
to Election Authority.‑‑It shall be the duty of all the executive
authorities in the Federation, in the Province and all Local Authorities under
the administrative control of Federation and Province to assist the Election
Authority in the performance of its functions as may be required of them by the
Election Authority or its member or Officer authorised by the Election
Authority.
18‑B.‑‑Suspension of
Officer.‑‑(1) The Election Authority may at ‑arty time, for reasons
to be recorded in writing, suspend any officer performing the function of the
Returning Officers, Assistant Returning Officers, Presiding Officer, Assistant
Presiding Officer, Polling Officer, Delimitation Officer, Assistant
Delimitation Officer or any other public functionary assisting. Such Officer or
any member of the Police force or other law enforcing agency, who obstruct or
pretence or attempts to obstruct or prevent the conduct of, fair and impartial
polls or influence or attempts to interfere viz. an elector when he records his
vote or influence in any manner the polling staff or an elector or does any
other act calculated to influence the result of an elector arid made such
arrangements as it may consider necessary for the performance of the functions
of the officer so suspended.
(2) Where the Election Authority
proceeds against any person under subsection (1), it shall refer the matter to
the appropriate authority for taking disciplinary action against such person.
18‑C.‑‑Contempt
of Election Authority.‑‑Any proceedings before the Election
Authority including its Chairman or members independently shall be deemed to be
a judicial proceedings within the meaning of section 228 of the Pakistan Penal
Code, 1860, and the Election Authority shall be deemed to be a Court within the
meaning of sections 476 and 480 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1898.

Substitution of section 20 of Ordinance II of 1980

GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE I OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th January, 1999]
No. LEGIS.2-30/LAW/75-IX, dated
14-1-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 12th
January, 1999, is hereby published for general information:--
5. Substitution of section 20
of Ordinance II of 1980.‑‑In the said Ordinance, for section
20, the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"20.
Qualification of candidates and members.‑‑A person shall be
qualified to be a candidate and a member of the Local Council if‑‑
(a) he is a citizen of Pakistan
(b) he is not less than twenty‑one
years of age and is enrolled as a voter in any electoral roll of any local area
within the limits of Local Council in which the seat falls;
(c) he is of good character and
is not commonly known as one who violates Islamic Injunctions;
(d) he has not been convicted for
a crime involving moral turpitude or for giving false evidence, and
(e) he has not, after the
establishment of Pakistan, worked against the integrity of the country or
opposed the Ideology of Pakistan:
Provided that the
disqualifications specified in clause (c) shall not apply to a person who is a
non‑Muslim, but such a person shall have good moral reputation.

Substitution of section 21 of Ordinance II of 1980

BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE I OF 1999
An Ordinance further to amend Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th January, 1999]
No. LEGIS.2-30/LAW/75-IX, dated
14-1-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 12th
January, 1999, is hereby published for general information:--
6. Substitution of section 21
of Ordinance II of 1980.‑‑In the said Ordinance, for section
21, the following shall by substituted:‑‑
"21.‑‑Disqualification
of candidates and members.‑‑(1) A person shall be disqualified from
being elected as, and from being, a member of a Local Council, if‑‑
.
(a) he ceases to be a citizen of
Pakistan or acquires the citizenship of foreign State, or
(b) he is an undischarged
insolvent, or
(c) he is of unsound mind MW has
been so declared by a competent Court, or ,
(d) he is a whole time salaried
official of the Federal Government or a Provincial Government or of a public or
statutory Corporation, a Local Council or other local Authority;
(e) has been on conviction for an
offence involving moral turpitude sentenced to imprisonment for a term of not
less than six months.
Explanation.‑‑Moral
turpitude means anything that injures the moral fibre of a person and lowers
him down in moral values.
(f) he has been dismissed from
the service of Federal Government or a Provincial Government or of public or
statutory corporation on the ground of misconduct, unless a period of two years
has not elapsed since his dismissal, or
(g) he has in the service of
Federal Government or Provincial Government or of any statutory body or anybody
which is owned or controlled by the Government or in which the Government has a
controlling share or interest, unless a period of one year has not elapsed
since he ceased to be in such service, or
(h) he is found guilty of a
corrupt or illegal practice under any law for the time being in force, unless a
period of two years has elapsed from the date on which that order takes effect,
or
(i) he has been removed or
compulsory retired from the service of Federal Government, Provincial
Government or of a public or statutory corporation, on the ground of misconduct
unless a period of two years has not elapsed since his removal or compulsory
retirement; or
(j) he is a retired servant of
the Federal Government or the Provincial Government or of a public or statutory
corporation, a Local Council or other local Authority unless one year has
elapsed from the date of such retirement; or
(k) he is under contract for work
to be done or goods to be supplied to the Local Council concerned or has
otherwise any pecuniary interest in its affairs; or
(l) he is disqualified from the
membership of any elective body under any law for the time being in force; and
(m) he has been or is engaged
directly or indirectly in subversive or anti‑State activities or
propagating any opinion or acting in any manner prejudicial to the Ideology of
Pakistan or the sovereignty, integrity or security of Pakistan.
Explanation.‑‑Anti‑State
activities shall include instigation to students, labour or any other section
of people with a view to promote lawlessness or disorder.
(2) No order passed under
subsection (1) shall be called in question in any Court.
